assumptions.statement: The site and three key-area polygons are repository provisional rough geometry, not official planning boundaries.
assumptions.impact: All spatial layers, figures and precision-sensitive metrics must be regenerated when trusted official polygons are published.

assumptions.statement: Official FAR, height, density, setbacks, road redlines, heritage controls, ownership, utilities and fire-safety conditions are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: No statutory development-control, demolition, engineering-feasibility or approval conclusion is made.

assumptions.statement: Submitted building footprints are conceptual ground-floor modules rather than surveyed existing buildings.
assumptions.impact: Retain, renovate, demolish and infill decisions require a rights-cleared building survey and ownership review.

assumptions.statement: The proposal has not surveyed current childcare, health, eldercare, staffing or opening-hour capacity.
assumptions.impact: Service-hour and program recommendations are pilots to be co-designed with care recipients, caregivers and operators.

assumptions.statement: The continuous step-free route is a design objective, not a verified statement of current accessibility.
assumptions.impact: A professional barrier-free and night-time field audit must precede detailed design.

assumptions.statement: No resident, child, older-adult or worker interview was conducted for this AI-generated submission.
assumptions.impact: Personas are design lenses only and cannot be presented as consent or measured local demand.
